elements.label: About
elements.value: Mid-air movement responsiveness — how much the player can steer while airborne.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/air_movement.schema.json, set am_c_level to {{am_c_level}}]
Set air control to {{am_c_level}} for the character. Restricted=high airControlFactor (sluggish), Full=low airControlFactor (responsive).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/air_movement.schema.json, set am_t_air_factor to {{am_t_air_factor}}]
Set MovementAbility.airControlFactor to {{am_t_air_factor}}. Lower = more responsive air control.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/air_movement.schema.json, set am_t_decel to {{am_t_decel}}]
Set MovementAbility.decelerationFactor to {{am_t_decel}}. Affects how quickly the character stops when input is released.
